visual_identity.technique: Layered dry-brushing; highlights use 'Pyrite Gold' impasto to create a metallic, mineral-flecked skin texture, mapped evenly along its horizontal profile.
visual_identity.lighting: Atmospheric scattering; soft, diffused 'Limestone White' glow from above hitting the powerful neck muscles, illuminating the lateral profile cleanly.
visual_identity.patterning: High-contrast 'Charcoal' banding on the flippers, rendered with aggressive, quick palette-knife swipes, with the paddles flattened to the camera plane.

pose: The rhomaleosaurid is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original 'S-curve' banking turn is completely unrolled into a flat, level, straight cruising path. This layout configuration stretches its robust skull, powerful intermediate-length neck, broad torso, and tail end-to-end to cleanly trace alongside the central UI measuring tape system for precise top-by-bottom length comparisons.
